findings.title: Container needs a ServiceAccount token that is not mounted
findings.cause: container watcher exits because it cannot read its ServiceAccount token, and its ServiceAccount watcher sets automountServiceAccountToken: false, so the kubelet never mounted it; its log says: "cat: can't open '/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token': No such file or directory"; Deployment watcher has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container watcher exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container watcher's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
loading in-cluster config
cat: can't open '/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token': No such file or directory

evidence.what: its ServiceAccount watcher sets automountServiceAccountToken: false

findings.fix: If the app talks to the Kubernetes API, set automountServiceAccountToken: true on the pod (it overrides the ServiceAccount), or mount a projected serviceAccountToken volume; if it does not, find why it tries.
